transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me today. I hope I'm not taking up too much of your time. Um, well, I guess I'm just having a little trouble staying focused lately? It's probably nothing major, just normal everyday stuff, you know? 

Like, I'll be trying to fill out a job application, and then, I don't know, a car will drive by outside, or my phone will buzz, or I'll just get a random thought in my head, and suddenly I'm doing something completely different. I don't even realize I've stopped working on the application until later. It's just... I get pulled off track by every little thing. Is that something people usually come in for? I just want to make sure I'm not making a big deal out of nothing.
How long have you been having trouble staying focused?

Um, I guess it’s been... well, really noticeable for about a year and ten months? Give or take? 

I mean, I've always been a little bit scatterbrained, which is totally normal, right? But it really only got this disruptive after I had a soccer injury. It just kind of knocked me out of my usual routine, and... I don't know, I just haven't been able to get back on track since then. I hope that makes sense? I know a lot of people deal with injuries and bounce right back, so I feel a little silly that it messed up my focus so much, but yeah... almost two years. Is that a helpful timeline for you?
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless when you're sitting still?

Um... maybe a little bit? I mean, I think it's pretty normal to need to move around sometimes, right? 

But I guess, yeah, if I’m sitting with someone, my leg is usually bouncing. Or, um, I’ll be clicking a pen, or just kind of messing with my keys in my pocket. The thing is, I don't even realize I’m doing it most of the time until I catch myself. I really try hard not to be annoying or distracting to other people with it, it's just... I guess my hands just like to be busy? 

I hope I'm not doing it too much right now, I know it can be a bad habit. Is that the kind of thing you're asking about?
Do you often interrupt others when they're speaking or blurt out answers before they've finished asking a question?

Um, I try really hard not to be rude, but... yeah, I guess I do that sometimes? It's definitely not on purpose, I promise. 

It's just, like, if I'm talking to my mom, or, um, the counselor I was seeing, they'll be asking me something and the answer will just pop right into my head. And before I can even stop myself, it just kind of tumbles out of my mouth before they're even finished talking. I always feel really bad about it afterwards because I know it's not polite to cut people off. I really am working on trying to wait my turn to speak. Does that make sense? I hope I'm not coming across as disrespectful or anything.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking, like doing something sudden without considering the consequences?

Um, no, not really. I mean, I try to be pretty careful about things, you know? 

I think everyone has moments where they might do something a little spontaneous, which is okay, right? But I wouldn't say I just do things without thinking about what might happen. I really try to be responsible and make good choices. I don't want to cause any trouble or make things harder for anyone else. 

I hope that's the right answer? I just... I really do try to think things through as best as I can.
Have you noticed any problems at work, school, or in your relationships due to your difficulty staying focused or other behaviors we've discussed?

Um, well, I guess maybe a little bit? I mean, I really try my best to stay on top of things, I promise. 

But, um, I have been trying to become an automotive technician. I'm really good at the hands-on stuff, you know? I know I can do the actual work. It's just... I guess I've missed a few training deadlines here and there. And, um, I've had to redo some applications because I missed some details the first time around. So I haven't really moved forward with it as much as I'd like to yet. 

I'm really trying to get better at keeping track of all that paperwork stuff, though. It's just a little overwhelming sometimes, but I don't want you to think I'm lazy or not trying. I really do want to get a good job and be responsible. Is it normal to struggle with that kind of stuff sometimes?
Were you often restless or fidgety when you were a child?

Um, well... I guess I was a little bit energetic when I was younger? But I think most kids are, right? I really tried to be a good student, I promise. 

But, um, I guess even back in elementary school, my teachers were always having to move my seat around. It wasn't because I was trying to be bad or anything! It's just... I guess I talked out of turn sometimes, and I'd forget my homework, or I'd rush through my worksheets and make some careless mistakes. I always felt terrible when they got frustrated with me. I really wanted them to like me and think I was smart. 

I hope that doesn't make me sound like I was a troublemaker. I really did want to do well in school, it was just hard to sit still and do everything exactly right all the time. Is that okay? Like, is it normal for kids to struggle with that kind of stuff?
Did you have difficulty playing quietly or engaging in leisure activities as a child?

Um, well, I guess... maybe a little? I mean, I really enjoy hanging out with my family and stuff, you know? I want to be part of what everyone's doing. 

But, um, I guess quiet stuff is kind of hard for me. Like, if my family is all watching a movie together, or if I'm just trying to sit and read a book... I don't know, I just sort of end up talking, or I need to get up to grab something, or I might be tapping my foot or making some noise. I really don't mean to bother anyone, I swear! I just... I get a little antsy, I guess. I try really hard to be quiet and let them enjoy the movie, but it just kind of happens before I realize it. 

I don't want to ruin things for everyone else. Do you think that's super annoying? I really try to be respectful of people's quiet time, I just struggle with it sometimes.
Have you ever had difficulty organizing tasks or activities?

Um, well... I guess organization isn't my absolute strongest skill? I mean, I really try to keep things neat and get my chores done, I promise. I want to be helpful and productive.

But, um, sometimes if I have a bunch of things on my plate... like, say I need to call the counselor, and clean up my room, and maybe work on sending in one of those applications... I just kind of look at it all and I'm not really sure which one is the most important to start with. So I'll sort of start cleaning, and then remember the application, so I go look at that, and then I think about the phone call... and I just kind of bounce around between them. And then at the end of the day, I've got a bunch of things half-finished. 

I'm really trying to get better at making lists and sticking to them, though! I don't want you to think I'm just ignoring my responsibilities. It just gets a little jumbled in my head sometimes. Is it okay to struggle with figuring out where to start when you have a lot to do?
Have you been experiencing any significant feelings of anxiety, sadness, or irritability lately?

Um, no, not really. I mean, I guess everyone gets a little stressed or bummed out sometimes, right? But I definitely wouldn't say it's anything significant or... or bad. 

I really try to stay positive and keep a good attitude about things. Even when I get a little overwhelmed with, you know, my chores or trying to figure out what to do next, I don't let it get me down too much. I don't want to be a burden on anyone or bring the mood down. I'm usually pretty okay, I promise. 

I hope that's a good thing? Like, it's normal to just feel okay most of the time, isn't it?
Do you ever find yourself so intensely focused on something that you lose track of everything else around you?

Um, no, not really. I mean... I guess I can pay attention just fine when I need to, you know? Like, if someone is talking to me or if I'm supposed to be doing something, I try really hard to be present and respectful. 

I don't think I ever get so wrapped up in something that I just ignore people or forget what's going on around me. I'd hate to make anyone feel like I'm ignoring them or that I don't care about what they're saying. I always try to be responsive when my family needs me. 

I mean, I might get into a video game or a project for a bit, but I can always snap out of it if someone calls my name. That's the right way to be, right? You're supposed to be able to pull yourself away when people need you?
Were your focus and behavior issues noticeable to you or others before your soccer injury?

Um, well... yeah, I guess they were. I mean, I really don't want to sound like I was a bad kid or anything, because I always meant well! I really wanted to be a good student. 

But, um... even back in elementary school, my teachers were, well, they were always having to move my seat. I guess I had a bad habit of talking out of turn, and... and I'd forget my homework a lot. I'd also kind of rush through my worksheets and make a bunch of careless mistakes. I wasn't trying to be disrespectful or lazy, I promise! I just... I don't know, I always felt bad when the teachers got frustrated with me. 

I've always tried really hard to do better, though. It's okay that I struggled a little bit when I was younger, right? Like, a lot of kids have trouble sitting still and doing homework, don't they?
Have you ever found yourself so focused on a task or activity that you lost track of time or forgot about everything else around you?

Um, I think you might have just asked me something like that, but... no, I really don't think I do that. 

I mean, I know sometimes people can get super intense about their hobbies, but I try really hard not to be like that. I don't want to be the kind of person who just checks out and ignores everyone, you know? That feels kind of rude. 

If I'm doing something, I always try to keep one ear open just in case my mom or dad needs help with something around the house. I want to be helpful and present. I don't ever want them to feel like I'm ignoring them because I'm too wrapped up in my own stuff. 

So, yeah, I'm pretty good at stopping what I'm doing when I need to. That's a good habit to have, right? Being able to put things down when people need you?
Did your difficulty staying focused and other behaviors we've discussed cause significant problems in your social relationships?

Um, well... I guess socially I do okay. I mean, I really try to be a good friend and be there for people. I don't want to be a burden on anyone, you know? 

But, um... I guess where it really causes problems is more with... well, with trying to get my career going. I really want to be an automotive technician. I know I can do the hands-on work, I'm actually really good at that part! But... I've kind of messed up some of the other stuff. 

I've, um, missed some training deadlines, and I've had to redo my applications a few times because I keep messing them up or forgetting things. It's really embarrassing. I'm 26 and I'm still not moving forward, even though I want to so badly. I'm not trying to be lazy, I really do want to work! I just... I get so overwhelmed with the paperwork and the deadlines, and I end up messing it up. 

It's okay that I'm struggling a bit with this, right? Like, a lot of people have a hard time with paperwork and deadlines when they're trying to start a career, don't they? I just don't want you to think I'm not trying.
Did your symptoms of inattention, such as difficulty staying focused, cause significant problems before the age of 12?

Um, well, yeah... I think we talked about this a little bit earlier, but... yes. I mean, I really don't want you to think I was a bad kid or a troublemaker, because I really did want to please my teachers! But, um... yeah, even back in elementary school, they were always having to move my seat around. 

I guess I just... I talked out of turn sometimes, and I'd forget to bring my homework in. And when we had worksheets, I'd kind of rush through them and make careless mistakes. I wasn't trying to be sloppy, I promise! I just wanted to get it done so the teacher would be happy. 

But it definitely caused some issues back then. I mean, it's pretty normal for little kids to be a bit squirmy and forgetful, right? I just hope you know I was always trying my best to be a good student.
Did you have any of these difficulties with focus or behavior before you were 7 years old?

Um, before I was seven? Gosh, that's... that's really far back. Um... I don't really think so? 

I mean, I don't really remember having any major problems back when I was that little. I think I was just a pretty normal, happy kid, you know? Playing and stuff. If I was a little energetic, well, that's just how little boys are at that age, right? 

I don't think my parents or teachers were worried about me back then. I really always tried to be a good boy and do what I was told. So, no, I don't think there was anything wrong before I was seven. That's okay, right? Not remembering anything bad from back then?
Did your parents or any of your family members notice you having trouble paying attention or behaving differently when you were really little, like before you started school?

Um, no, I don't think so. I mean, my parents never really said anything about me being, like, a difficult toddler or anything. 

I think I was just a regular little kid, you know? Maybe a little busy sometimes, but my mom always said I was just a happy, curious boy. They never took me to a doctor or got mad at me for how I acted before I started school. I really tried to be good for them, even when I was tiny. 

So, yeah, I don't think my family noticed anything weird back then. It's pretty normal for little kids to just be playing and not really paying attention to stuff, right? I just don't want you to think I was, like, out of control or anything when I was little.
Did your parents or teachers ever mention that you had significant difficulties with attention or behavior before you were 7 years old?

Um, no, I... I really don't think so. I know you've asked about that age a few times now, and I hope it's okay that my answer is still no! 

I really don't remember my parents or my kindergarten teachers ever saying I was a problem back then. I mean, they might have said I was a little chatty or something, but nothing bad, you know? They never pulled my parents aside to say I couldn't focus or that I was misbehaving. I was always trying so hard to be a good listener for them. 

I really hope that's alright, that I don't have any bad stories from before I was seven. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Did your parents or teachers notice any of these difficulties with focus or behavior before you were 12 years old?

Oh, um, before I was twelve? So, like, during elementary school? 

Well... I guess maybe around then, things were a little bit different. I really hope you don't think I was a troublemaker or anything, because I promise I wasn't trying to be! But, um... yeah, my teachers actually did have to move my seat around a lot back then. I just liked everyone so much, you know, so sometimes I'd accidentally talk out of turn. 

And I'd forget my homework sometimes, even though I really meant to do it and bring it in. I also kind of rushed through my worksheets and made, you know, just some careless little mistakes. I always felt so bad when they pointed it out because I really wanted them to be happy with my work. 

Is... is that the kind of thing you mean? I hope it's okay to admit that I did have a little bit of trouble once I got older.
Have you experienced difficulties with focus or behavior in multiple settings, such as at home, at work, or in social situations?

Um, well... I mean, I guess it kind of happens a little bit everywhere? But not in a bad way, I promise! 

Like, at home, my mom sometimes gets a little frustrated because I'll start cleaning my room and then get distracted and leave, like, a pile of laundry on the bed. But I always go back and finish it when she reminds me! I really try to help out around the house. 

And, um, since I'm not working right now, I don't really have work stories, but with my friends... I guess sometimes I might interrupt or lose track of what we're talking about if there's a lot going on around us. But my friends are really great, they know I don't mean to be rude or anything. I just get a little overly excited sometimes. 

I hope that makes sense? I really try my best to be good wherever I am, I just... sometimes my brain gets a little ahead of me, I guess. Is that what you were asking about?
